answer: Correlated-error fingerprinting: each epoch the network slips trap questions with plausible wrong turns into ordinary tasks. Independent agents err in diverse ways, but a sybil farm run by one operator shares a model, prompt and config, so its mistakes cluster like quartz facets grown from one seed. Identities whose error vectors match too closely are treated as one basalt block split into tiles and share a single reward weight, until later traps show they sail from a different harbor.
